jobs.description: Silver refresh of the 대수선 lane `building-permit-major-repair` (root ADR-0169 ②, ADR-0402): pick the newest complete hub.go.kr release in the Bronze ledger and, unless silver.building_permit_major_repair already records it or a newer one (`unchanged`), export it, compare it, in the publisher's DuckDB, with the table's current rows in one bucket and append to main only the rows it has not held and a removal marker per row it no longer holds (each row keyed by its SHA-256) (lane contract compare.content_columns; root ADR-0318), and read it back (`changed`). Started when a source_sweep run lands new files, and daily as the fallback (root ADR-0171). Two of the duckdb pool's runs go at a time, lanes or other in-process work: each holds one of its slots and a memory_claim on its unit (root ADR-0599, ADR-0605).
jobs.memory_measured: 2026-11-21, building-register-units. Under 16G: three runs, export 6m47s-7m00s CPU and about 10 minutes of wall time, `memory peak` 13.3-13.4G. Under the 8G this cap was for one day: one run, 61 minutes (17:37:58-18:39:25Z), 10m35s CPU, `memory peak` 7.2G - the export child held 6.68G resident and the cgroup sat at MemoryHigh with 18,933 `high` events and no OOM kill: throttled, not killed. journal `memory peak` 2026-10-18..11-08, 84 runs under 16G: highest 15,668M on 2026-10-20 (building-register-unit-areas). The other lanes measured on the DuckDB path the same day: 0.3G-7.1G.
jobs.memory_headroom_why: A measured working point, not 1.5 x a peak: the export sizes its workers to three quarters of what its cgroup has left, so its peak follows the cap, but about 7G of it does not shrink - at 8G nothing was left for it to work in. 16G is the cap under which the largest export is measured to finish in ten minutes. One number for all 54 lanes, because they share one unit template: it over-reserves for the small lanes (1-7G), and a request per lane comes with the Dagster resource tags that replace this admission (root ADR-0583 follow-up).

first_run.estimated_from: computed, about 2.5x the nearest larger measured neighbours on the same template unit (root ADR-0386): silver_refresh_building_permit_basis_outline 357 s for a 438 MB release, _parking 251 s for 59 MB, _demolition_loss 161 s for 15 MB; this lane's newest release is about 3 MB in the Bronze ledger (2026-11-09)

expected_outcome.basis: building HUB files are released monthly (expected_cadence monthly, 1080 h, in the endpoint catalog) plus one daily fallback; measured 2026-11-11 from each unit's journal, 10-12..11-11 (read-only): changed once, on its first load.

assets.title: 건축인허가 대수선
assets.description: 대수선 항목마다 한 행: 대수선구분(내력벽·기둥·보·방화구획 등)·변경구분(증설·해체·수선·변경)과 허가 키(관리허가대장PK). 건물 수명 사건열의 중간이다. 한 허가에 여러 행이라 행 글자의 SHA-256 이 키다. 원문 16칸 보존. 필지 by-PNU 종류 parcel-building-permits 가 행의 PNU 로 필지 문서의 목록 하나로 싣는다(루트 ADR-0402, ADR-0464).

dependencies.description: 대수선(mart_kcy_05) 16칸을 행마다 새 행·사라진 행만 append-only Silver 로 쌓는다(루트 ADR-0402).
dependencies.pnu_resolution: pnu composed at Silver by the Rust hub/VWorld export (export-*-silver-handoff, standard_pnu_from_hub_register_codes / ADR-0145), not a raw provider code; parcels since merged, split or recoded are carried to the current pnu by the consumer through the place-identity resolver and views.changed_codes (ADR-0288, ADR-0329, ADR-0402)
